## 更新内容 / Changes

- 加强 Claude Code 的协议边界：Claude CLI 账号必须明确使用 Anthropic Messages 协议。OpenAI Responses 等协议即使带有 Anthropic 身份或凭据类型，也会被兼容性检查、实例校验和凭据投影拒绝。
- 加强 Claude Desktop 诊断边界：应用身份文件 `Info.plist` 必须是稳定的普通文件，符号链接路径会被拒绝；Claude Desktop 仍保持计划状态，不会进入通用实例启动生命周期。
- 增加上述边界的回归测试，避免后续版本把 OpenAI 凭据或不受控的 Desktop 路径带入 Claude 集成。

- Strengthened the Claude Code protocol boundary: Claude CLI accounts must explicitly use the Anthropic Messages protocol. OpenAI Responses and other protocols are rejected by compatibility checks, instance validation and credential projection even when Anthropic identity metadata is present.
- Strengthened Claude Desktop diagnostics: the bundle `Info.plist` must be a stable regular file; symlinked paths are rejected. Claude Desktop remains planned and is not connected to the common instance launch lifecycle.
- Added regression coverage for these boundaries so later updates cannot route OpenAI credentials or uncontrolled Desktop paths into the Claude integration.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。关闭管理器窗口不会停止运行中的实例；实例全部结束并完成配置回收后管理器才会退出。账号、实例、会话和本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the manager window does not stop running instances; the manager exits after all instances finish and their configuration is restored. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code CLI 与 Claude Desktop 仍为计划功能；Claude CLI 的独立检测、登录、配置、隔离、协议和会话边界可供验证，但尚未接入实例向导或通用启动生命周期。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop remain planned integrations. Claude CLI has independently testable detection, login, configuration, isolation, protocol and session boundaries, but is not connected to the instance wizard or common launch lifecycle.

## 验证来源 / Verification

版本标签 `v0.6.1` 对应完整来源提交。GitHub Actions “Build release” 会运行公开仓库检查、macOS arm64 源码测试、打包检查并生成附件校验值。安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The `v0.6.1` tag identifies the complete source commit. GitHub Actions “Build release” runs the public repository check, macOS arm64 source tests, packaging checks and installer checksum generation. Installer hashes are provided in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
